Global powers accelerate critical mineral funding to secure rare earth supply chains. 🌍

Minning & Capital Projects

Engineering firms should position specialized METS-PMO and procurement services to manage long-lead items and maintain aggressive construction schedules for major regional builds.

Critical Minerals & Exploration
Coyote Copper secured crucial drill permit approvals and expanded its Copper Springs project footprint to address national declines in transition mineral production. Advisory practices can engage Coyote Copper early in the exploration phase to deploy AI-driven geological modeling and streamline baseline environmental data collection.

Lithium & Regional Development
Lithium Africa defined a second spodumene trend in Côte d'Ivoire, highlighting high-grade rock samples up to 1.98% Li2O alongside the Saby Trend in the Adzopé District. Geological consultants can propose targeted METS-PMO and exploration workflows to optimize drill targeting and resource estimation across emerging West African pegmatite corridors.

Transport & Infrastructure Logistics
The Lobito Atlantic Railway is drawing down $300 million of a $753 million package to double cargo volumes to 800,000 tons in 2027, reshaping critical mineral logistics amidst intensified US-China infrastructure competition. Logistics operators and mining houses should secure advisory support to optimize multi-modal transport networks and navigate sovereign compliance along the corridor.
